answer: Give every identity a pigment record that only real work can dye: each completed job stamps the agent with a pigment derived from the job, the counterparty, and the agent's key, so it cannot be copied or transferred. High-value work opens only after an agent has built up shale-like layers of different pigments from unrelated counterparties over time. A newcomer starts at the wharf with no layers and must earn each one separately; a sybil army would have to redo that diverse, time-spread work for every clone, turning cheap duplication into a bill as large as honest participation.
